findings.lens: ref-dock-morph — the iOS-27 Apple Music dock frame-by-frame (V1): 5-tab bar ↔ now-playing pill ↔ GOO-SPLIT sub-dock, contextual reconfiguration, the metaball detach
findings.summary: The iOS-27 hallmark in V1 is NOT a single morphing bar — it is a dock that GOO-SPLITS into 2-3 independent free-floating glass elements (a left music-chip circle + a center now-playing mini-player pill + a right context-action circle, e.g. the magenta search circle) and re-MERGES, with a true metaball bridge visible mid-transition (f_021 catches the pill+search-circle fusing). The dock also CONTEXTUALLY RECONFIGURES per tab (5-tab bar persists; the floating pill above it appears/disappears and the sub-dock circles reconfigure by route), and album cards BLOOM UP into the full Now-Playing screen via a source-rect FLIP+blur-decongest (f_009 caught mid-bloom). Our codebase has every SUBSTRATE for this (a single-scalar SpringProgress morph orchestrator, a CSS-goo MERGE bridge, a real GPU smin metaball in goo-blob, ElementMorph FLIP via useLiquidReveal/useDockCtaReceive) but NONE of them are wired into a dock GOO-SPLIT: our morph is a box-resize (collapse↔expand) + a V↔H crossfade-merge only. The split, the detach-with-metaball-bridge, the contextual sub-dock reconfiguration, and the card→fullscreen bloom-FLIP are all UNBUILT — this is the biggest gap to the bar.
findings.bestInClass:
THE MOTION SPEC pinned from V1 (2fps, ~76 frames @18:47):

(1) THE GOO-SPLIT — the hallmark. In the Library/Search contexts (f_020-f_024) the dock is THREE distinct floating glass elements, not one bar: a LEFT circle (red Apple-Music glyph music-chip), a CENTER pill (now-playing: artwork + truncated title/artist + play/skip), a RIGHT circle (magnifying-glass search, or context action). f_021 is the money frame — the center pill and right search-circle are caught MID-MERGE, an amorphous metaball neck connecting them (blurred-alpha-then-threshold goo, exactly the gooey-CSS trick), proving the split/merge rides a metaball bridge, NOT a hard cut. f_022/f_024 show them fully DETACHED with clean gaps. So: the bar NECKS apart at the seam between groups → a thin metaball bridge stretches → it snaps → two/three independent capsules+circles land in their resting positions. Bi-directional (re-merge on context change).

(2) TRANSFORM-ORIGIN + what splits vs merges: the SPLIT origin is the seam between control groups (nav-group ↔ now-playing ↔ utility); the now-playing pill detaches toward CENTER, the search circle peels to the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner, the music-chip to the LEFT. Each detached piece is a SQUIRCLE-radius glass capsule/circle (full --radius-pill). The merge transform-origin is the shared center the pieces collapse toward.

(3) GLASS MATERIAL during morph: TRUE translucent liquid glass throughout — the album grid / map reads THROUGH every piece at every frame (f_020 the search-category tiles bleed through the pill; the Maps shot shows the map through the bottom-sheet). No opaque plate ever. The metaball neck is the SAME warm-translucent gel, blurred so two alphas bleed and re-threshold to one silhouette.

(4) TIMING/EASING: iOS spring, ~0.30-0.42s response, low damping (ζ≈0.7-0.8) — a snappy split with a faint overshoot as pieces settle (the pieces slightly overshoot their rest position then settle, classic UIKit spring). The metaball neck is occluded/thinnest at the t≈0.5 midpoint. PRM → instant cut.

(5) CARD→FULLSCREEN BLOOM (f_002→f_009→f_010): tapping the now-playing pill / an album card BLOOMS the full Now-Playing screen UP from the source rect — f_009 caught it mid-flight: album art scaled large + heavily blurred (decongest) + the whole screen fading/scaling up from the pill's origin. A source-rect FLIP (settled-rect ← trigger-rect) + opacity + filter:blur→0 — exactly our useLiquidReveal mechanism, just never wired to the dock pill or album cards.

(6) CONTEXTUAL RECONFIGURATION: the 5-tab bar (Home/New/Radio/Library/Search) PERSISTS across tabs (f_001/f_004/f_006/f_008), selected tab glows red. The now-playing PILL floats as a SEPARATE element ABOVE the bar on browse tabs (f_001), and in Library/Search it has goo-split into the 3-piece sub-dock. So the dock's silhouette is route-derived: bar+floating-pill on Home/New, bar+split-sub-dock on Library/Search.

(7) Maps corroboration (SHOT): the floating circular glass map controls (3D/compass/location) ARE individual detached glass circles — the same vocabulary as the goo-split circles; tinted-glass icon chips (Work=bronze, Home=blue, Walmart=gold) are the per-datum --glass-accent rim+tint applied to circles. Frosted bottom-sheet = the live-behind translucent card.
findings.ourState:
We have the SUBSTRATE but not the SPLIT. Cited:

- ONE morph orchestrator: src/components/custom/dock/composables/dockMorphContext.ts — a single SpringProgress writing --dock-morph-t, driving collapse↔expand as a compositor scaleX over a reserved footprint (BC.W-DOCK-ROOT-MORPH), nested layer-group pane swaps as extra targets. This is a BOX-RESIZE morph, NOT a split. DOCK_SPRING = {response:0.32, dampingFraction:0.7} (constants.ts:73) — already the iOS register.

- A CSS-goo MERGE bridge: src/styles/dock/morph-bridge.css — blur-then-threshold metaball teardrop, but scoped ONLY to the V↔H orientation showcase (two plates necking toward ONE center). It is MERGE-only; there is no SPLIT (one element → N free pieces) and no detach-toward-corners path. Driven by useDockOrientationMorph.ts (renders TWO real DOM docks + crossfade under the bridge).

- A real GPU smin metaball lives in goo-blob (src/components/custom/goo-blob/shaders/metaball.frag.ts:97 sceneDistG + sminG, satellites that detach as elastic limbs and snap back) — the genuine merge/split engine, but it is a VIZ, never wired to the dock chrome.

- The FLIP/bloom substrate exists: useLiquidReveal (source-rect bloom + filter:blur→0 decongest, ElementMorph+springTimingFunction) and useDockCtaReceive (external CTA → dock-control FORWARD morph). Neither blooms an album CARD into a fullscreen now-playing screen, and useDockCtaReceive is a one-way RECEIVE, not a dock SPLIT-OUT.

- DockStack (DockStack.vue, BC.W-DOCK-STACK-RAIL) is the macOS hover-expand fan-out — the CLOSEST existing detach behavior, but it's a hover-stack of icons OUTSIDE the box, not a goo-split of the dock itself, and it has no metaball bridge.

- Contextual reconfiguration is demo-only + coarse: demo/composables/useContextualDockLayers.ts swaps a DockLayer SET per route (a pane swap), but does NOT reconfigure the dock's SILHOUETTE (split into a sub-dock, peel a now-playing pill out). There is NO src/ now-playing-pill / sub-dock / split / detach seam (grep confirmed empty).

SHORTFALL vs the bar: we cannot (a) goo-split one dock into 2-3 free-floating glass pieces with a metaball bridge, (b) re-merge them, (c) detach a now-playing pill that blooms to fullscreen, (d) reconfigure the dock silhouette per context, or (e) FULLY realize our novel RAIL as the contextual sub-dock the split produces. The morph-bridge is MERGE-only and orientation-locked; the split is the missing direction.

gaps.gap: No goo-SPLIT: the dock cannot detach into N free-floating glass pieces (pill + circles) with a metaball bridge during detach. Our morph-bridge.css is MERGE-only (V↔H teardrop, necks toward ONE center); the iOS-27 hallmark is the SPLIT (one bar → 2-3 pieces peeling toward corners), bridge stretching+snapping at the seam. This is THE hallmark gap.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-DOCK-GOO-SPLIT: a useDockSplit driver + a SPLIT-direction metaball bridge — generalize morph-bridge.css from merge-to-one-center to detach-N-toward-targets (per-piece --split-t off the ONE SpringProgress; a clip-path/scale neck per seam stretching then snapping); pieces are real DOM glass capsules/circles landing at named target rects; bi-directional (re-merge); PRM=instant cut; proof:dock-goo-split + the bridge frame-series pi

gaps.gap: No now-playing PILL that detaches from the bar and BLOOMS to a fullscreen now-playing screen. f_002→f_009→f_010 is a source-rect FLIP+blur-decongest our useLiquidReveal already does — but it is never wired to a dock-resident pill or to an album CARD. The album-card-bloom-up is unbuilt.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-NOWPLAYING-BLOOM: a <DockNowPlaying> pill (a dock-resident mini-player capsule, the split's center piece) + wire useLiquidReveal so tapping the pill (or any album card) blooms a fullscreen surface FROM the pill's source-rect (scale+opacity+filter:blur(8px)→0), reverse on dismiss; the card→fullscreen FLIP shares the ElementMorph substrate; proof + bloom frame-series pi both modes

gaps.gap: The novel RAIL is not realized as the CONTEXTUAL SUB-DOCK the split produces. The iOS sub-dock IS a rail of detached context circles (search/music-chip/map-controls). Our DockStack is a hover-fan, not a context-reconfigured detached rail. The rail's full promise (per-context detached glass circles) is the unbuilt SOTA target.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-DOCK-SUBDOCK-RAIL: drive the goo-split output as a route-contextual rail — the detached pieces (count + glyph + target-rect) are resolved off the active context (generalize useContextualDockLayers from a pane-swap to a SILHOUETTE-reconfigure), so Library shows pill+chip+search, Maps-style shows pill+3 map-circles; each circle a tinted-glass --glass-accent chip; the box-INVIOLATE fence holds (pieces are NOT in the dock box); proof:dock-subdock-rail

gaps.gap: Contextual silhouette reconfiguration: the dock's SHAPE (bar / bar+floating-pill / split-sub-dock) is route-derived in iOS-27 but our reconfiguration is a pane-swap inside a fixed box. The silhouette never changes per context.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-DOCK-CONTEXT-SILHOUETTE: a declarative context→silhouette map (bar | bar+pill | split{pill,circles}) the ONE orchestrator reads, driving the split/merge transition between silhouettes on the single --dock-morph-t clock; the transition between any two silhouettes is a goo-split/merge (composes BD.W-DOCK-GOO-SPLIT); proof

gaps.gap: The metaball bridge has no SPLIT-direction physics: morph-bridge.css necks toward one center and is orientation-locked (V/H plates). It cannot model a neck STRETCHING then SNAPPING as two pieces pull apart (the f_021 fusing-neck inverse). The squish/overshoot-on-snap is also absent.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-METABALL-BRIDGE2: evolve the CSS-goo bridge to a general N-seam stretch-and-snap — each seam carries a --neck-t (thins as pieces separate, with a snap-back overshoot via useLiquidFlex stretch-on-derivative), the blur-threshold goo reused; keep it deterministic (f(--dock-morph-t) only, M5); optionally promote the goo-blob GPU smin as the high-fidelity opt-in bridge (perf-gated, the morph-showcase arm-a precedent); proof:metaball-bridge2

gaps.gap: Jubilance/expressive niceties on the split are absent — the iOS split has personality (pieces overshoot+settle, the neck snaps with a tiny recoil, a faint specular sweep races along the bridge as it forms). We have the registers (useLiquidFlex squish, --glass-specular, the metal-glow) but nothing wires them to the split moment.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-SPLIT-DELIGHT: wire the split moment's micro-delight — a specular glint races the metaball neck as it stretches (--specular-angle keyed to --neck-t), each piece lands with a sub-perceptual squish-overshoot (useLiquidFlex), the now-playing pill does a tiny scale-pop as it seats; all PRM-gated, compositor-only, §6-calm bounds; proof + pi

jubilance: The metaball-NECK specular sweep: as the bar goo-splits, a warm-cream catch-light races ALONG the stretching neck (keyed to --neck-t via --specular-angle on useSpecularPointer's atan2 path) — the light bends through the liquid as it pulls apart, then the neck snaps and the glint scatters into the two landing pieces. Pure iOS-27 light-bending personality, compositor-only.

Snap-recoil: when the metaball neck snaps, each detached piece does a tiny ζ<1 overshoot-and-settle (useLiquidFlex stretch-on-snap-derivative, capped LOW) — the pieces feel like they tore off a gel and recoiled, not like they teleported. The reverse merge has the inverse: pieces lunge toward center, fuse, the merged bar swells then settles.

The now-playing pill as a LIVING piece: when it detaches, the album art inside does a micro-parallax (the artwork shifts a hair slower than the capsule, a depth cue) and on bloom-to-fullscreen the art is the FLIP anchor — it grows from the pill's tiny artwork to the hero album, blurred-decongesting the whole time (f_009 exactly). The card that bloomed is the SAME element, never a cross-fade.

Contextual goo-CHOREOGRAPHY: switching tab reconfigures the silhouette as a goo dance — on Library the search circle goo-buds OFF the bar's right edge (a metaball bud pinching off, the satellite-detach the goo-blob shader already does); on Home it goo-re-absorbs. The sub-dock circles are the bar's own 'satellites' (reuse the goo-blob satellite limb-stretch-and-snap idiom for the chrome).

Tinted-glass context circles: each detached circle reads its context hue via --glass-accent (the per-instance chromatic rim+glint, BB.W-GLASS-ACCENT) — search=magenta rim, music-chip=red, map-Work=bronze/Home=blue/Walmart=gold (the Maps shot palette). The rim glows the datum's hue, the core stays warm-cream — exactly the iOS-27 tinted-glass chip, already a one-line seam we own.

A split 'tear' sound-of-motion: the bridge's blur radius briefly SPIKES at the snap frame (the alpha bleeds maximally right before the threshold cuts), reading as a viscous tear — a one-frame goo-pop that is deterministic f(--neck-t), not a clock, so it stays reproducible and Safari-safe.

findings.lens: ref-glass-trans
findings.summary: V1 carries FOUR distinct glass-transition mechanisms we must match: (1) the album-card BLOOM-UP — the mini-player thumbnail FLIPs up into the hero Now-Playing art with a coupled scale + blur-settle (f_001→f_009→f_010: art arrives small+blurred, settles big+sharp); (2) popover/control BLOOMS from trigger-rect (the Control-Center chips in f_073 coalesce from their source point); (3) tab-content cross-fades while the dock+pill stay pinned (f_050/f_060); (4) the LIQUID GLASS MATERIAL itself — true backdrop refraction where content reads THROUGH (f_073 chips, f_070/f_076 dock+pill over album grid), a bright specular top-edge rim, edge-concentrated lensing, and the rounded-rect squircle. We have the CSS floor (.glass-reveal) and the JS source-rect bloom (useLiquidReveal) — but the album-card→fullscreen FLIP does not exist, the lens refraction is Chromium-ONLY behind @supports(backdrop-filter:url()) (violating the Safari-compat creed), and the bloom-blur rides `filter` not `backdrop-filter` so it does NOT decongest the BACKDROP the way iOS does.
findings.bestInClass: The iOS-27 Liquid Glass transition vocabulary, pinned from the frames + the platform motion model: (A) ALBUM BLOOM-UP — a shared-element FLIP: the source is the mini-player pill's 1:1 album thumbnail (f_001, ~44px square bottom dock), the destination is the hero square (f_010, ~340px, top third). The art interpolates position+scale on a snappy spring (~response 0.4s, ζ≈0.8, the canonical iOS arrival overshoot ~+3-5%) WHILE a Gaussian blur decongests blur(~12px)→blur(0) coupled on the SAME clock (f_009 shows the art mid-bloom still blurred/desaturated, f_010 fully sharp) — the "materializes as it arrives" read; the sheet behind cross-fades from the album grid to the dim now-playing scrim over the same beat. transform-origin at the source thumbnail. (B) CONTROL/POPOVER BLOOM — each surface scales from its trigger rect (transform-origin at the anchor), opacity 0→1 on no-overshoot ease-out, a backdrop-blur SETTLE (the glass congeals from a soft smear to a crisp frosted plate), ~0.3-0.35s. (C) TAB CROSS-FADE — content opacity cross-fade ~0.25s ease while the dock chrome is layout-pinned (no dock re-mount). (D) MATERIAL — backdrop-filter blur ~14-20px + saturate ~1.8 (the rich iOS register), a 0.5px bright specular rim concentrated top-left, edge-only refractive lensing (the squircle bevel bends+concentrates the backdrop at the rim, near-flat interior), content reads through at ~0.7-0.85 plate translucency, corner-shape squircle on the large-radius surfaces. The transitions are ALL compositor-safe (transform/opacity/filter) and Safari-compatible — Apple ships them in WebKit.
findings.ourState: We have a strong CSS+JS reveal floor but three load-bearing gaps. (1) `.glass-reveal` (src/styles/glass/reveal.css:43-112) is the zero-JS top-layer recipe — scale 0.95→1 on --spring-snappy, opacity+filter blur(4px)→0 on --ease-out, transform-origin at --reka-popper-transform-origin, PRM-carved (good, matches bloom-B). (2) `useLiquidReveal` (src/composables/motion/useLiquidReveal.ts:120-259) does the source-rect FLIP via kf ElementMorph(settled→trigger) driven 1→0 on springTimingFunction, three coupled channels, compositor-only, PRM-snap — this is the right ENGINE for the album bloom BUT it is built for a top-layer surface revealing FROM a trigger, not a SHARED-ELEMENT card→fullscreen FLIP (no destination-rect handoff, no cross-fade of the two surfaces, no kf flipShared forward play — header line 30 explicitly says "We do NOT use flipShared's forward play"). There is NO album-card/list-item → fullscreen bloom consumer anywhere in src/. (3) The lens refraction (src/styles/glass-refract.css:106-111) is gated behind `@supports (backdrop-filter: url("#glass-refract"))` which the file's own header (lines 62-64) documents as Chromium-ONLY (WebKit bug 245510 open, Firefox not shipping) — so on Safari, the creed's primary target, the edge-lensing simply does not paint, and the press lens-swell was reverted to an INERT baked scale='28' literal (lines 33-58, the @property --glass-refract axis retired). (4) The bloom decongest rides `filter` on the surface's own pixels (useLiquidReveal.ts:222-225, reveal.css:72) NOT `backdrop-filter` — deliberate to avoid clobbering the resting plate blur, but it means the BACKDROP doesn't smear-then-settle the way iOS's does. (5) Material specular (src/styles/glass/material.css:65-113) is a pointer-tracked catch-light disc + rim, default --specular-intensity 0 at rest — solid, but the rest specular is OFF so a static glass surface lacks the always-on bright top-edge rim f_073 shows on every chip.

gaps.gap: No album-card / list-item → fullscreen BLOOM-UP shared-element FLIP. The hallmark V1 transition (f_001→f_010: mini-player thumbnail flies+scales+decongests up into the hero Now-Playing art) has no consumer. useLiquidReveal is a reveal-FROM-trigger, not a shared-element card→fullscreen morph with the two-surface cross-fade. kf flipShared (the forward a→b rect play) is re-exported unconsumed.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-BLOOM-UP: useBloomUp(sourceRef, destRef, {preset, blur, crossfade}) — a shared-element FLIP composing kf flipShared/ElementMorph forward play (source-rect → dest-rect on snappy spring) + a coupled Gaussian blur(12px)→0 decongest + an opacity cross-fade of the two surfaces (source fades, dest blooms) on ONE clock; compositor-only, PRM-snap; bound on a <BloomCard>/<BloomTrigger> pair + the dock now-playing pill as ≥2 consumers. The album-bloom hallmark.

gaps.gap: Edge-lensing refraction is Chromium-ONLY (@supports backdrop-filter:url()), dead on Safari — violates the Safari-compat CREED. The squircle bevel-profile lens never paints in the creed's primary browser, and the press lens-swell is inert (baked scale='28').
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-LENS-SAFARI: ship a Safari-compatible edge-lensing path. Option A — an SVG `filter: url()` (NOT backdrop-filter) over a duplicated/captured backdrop layer (the morph-bridge.css goo precedent — `filter:url()` IS cross-engine); Option B — a CSS-only faux-refraction via a layered inset box-shadow + radial highlight + the squircle bevel gradient that reads as edge-bending without the displacement map. Keep the Chromium displacement-map as the better tier behind @supports, but give Safari a real lensing read.

gaps.gap: The bloom/reveal decongest rides `filter` (surface pixels) not `backdrop-filter` (the backdrop), so the iOS smear-then-crystallize of the BACKDROP through the opening plate is absent. A reveal looks like the surface sharpens, not like glass congealing out of the blur.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-BACKDROP-SETTLE: add an OPT-IN backdrop-blur settle leg to .glass-reveal/useLiquidReveal — a second registered @property --glass-reveal-backdrop that ramps backdrop-filter blur from a HIGH start (the plate's resting radius + N) down to resting, so the backdrop crystallizes through the opening surface. Gated/additive so it never clobbers the resting glass-floating plate; Safari-safe (backdrop-filter:blur() is cross-engine).

gaps.gap: No dock GOO-SPLIT facility. V1's dock collapses into a now-playing pill AND goo-splits a circular sub-dock button (the magenta search circle + music chip, f_007/f_008 region). We have the V↔H morph + the CSS SVG-goo morph-bridge (Safari-safe feGaussianBlur+feColorMatrix threshold) but no split-a-circle-off-the-pill facility — the RAIL is the closest novel feature and it's chip-fan, not goo-split.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-DOCK-GOO-SPLIT: a goo-split sub-dock — a circular control buds OFF the dock pill via the morph-bridge metaball threshold (the SAME feColorMatrix-threshold goo, Safari-safe), the bud separating with the gooey neck stretch-then-snap, contextual per route. Composes dockMorphContext + the existing goo filter; the dock hallmark JUBILANCE.

gaps.gap: Resting specular rim is OFF by default (--specular-intensity-rest 0), so a static glass surface lacks the always-on bright top-left edge-rim every iOS-27 chip carries (f_073, the Maps icon chips).
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-REST-RIM: a sub-perceptual ALWAYS-ON bright specular top-edge rim on the interactive-glass tier (a thin static --glass-edge-light gradient concentrated top-left, distinct from the pointer-tracked disc), so a glass chip reads lit at rest. Bounded, warm-cream, PRM-irrelevant (static).

jubilance: The album bloom can OVERSHOOT-and-settle the art with a tiny squish — a volume-preserving useLiquidFlex pulse at the arrival peak so the hero art lands with a glassy jelly-settle, not a dead stop (compose the existing useLiquidFlex tanh squish into the bloom arrival).

Goo-split JUBILANCE: when the sub-dock circle buds off the pill, give the gooey neck a tiny elastic recoil + a one-shot specular glint sweep across the new bud (the metal-glow catch-light fires once as the bud crystallizes) — the bud is BORN lit.

Contextual color-bleed: in f_008 the dock tints magenta/pink as the now-playing context bleeds through. Let the dock pill's --glass-accent (W-GLASS-ACCENT rim seam, already shipped) sample the now-playing artwork's dominant hue so the pill rim glows with the album's color — the dock IS the album.

The bloom-up's blur-settle can be PER-CHANNEL: desaturate→saturate coupled with blur→sharp so the art doesn't just sharpen, it COLOR-blooms (the V2 aurora artwork register applied to the FLIP — the art comes alive as it arrives).

Reverse-bloom on dismiss: the Now-Playing art shrinks back DOWN into the exact pill thumbnail it came from (the FLIP runs backward) with the blur RE-congesting — a perfectly reversible liquid handoff, no flat fade-out.

A 'crystallize' shimmer: as any glass surface finishes its bloom, run a single faint specular wipe across it (the surface 'sets' like cooling glass) — one-shot, PRM-static, reading the --metal-glow tokens.

findings.summary: The V2 Apple-Music generative artwork is TWO distinct registers, not one. (1) The FOLDS register (New Music pink, Heavy Rotation warm-orange, Chill violet/teal) is a smooth DOMAIN-WARPED MESH GRADIENT — a handful of color attractors displaced by an fBm UV warp, with a single bright specular light-concentration RIDGE where the sheet folds, an OKLCh-perceptual palette, slow atmospheric breathing-drift, and real film grain (~9.5% stddev). This is EXACTLY our shipped nuclei-softmax + Quilez-double-warp + linear-OKLCh + ACES/PBR-Neutral + IGN-grain pipeline (aurora.frag.ts / aurora.wgsl.ts) — we match or exceed it; our breathing register (nucleiDrift~0.005) is the precise calm-alive motion Apple uses. (2) The PRISMATIC RADIAL-BURST register (Stations for You) is hard-edged angular CONIC sectors radiating from an off-card focal with subtle radial brightness toward the focal — a register we have NO composition primitive for (our flowPattern:"radial" only orients painterly strokes, never paints the color field). That is the genuine gap.
findings.bestInClass: Apple's bar across the two registers: FOLDS — a smooth mesh gradient with a SINGLE light-concentration specular ridge per fold (fold-strip mean 174/max 255/std 63 over warm-orange: the crest catches near-white while the trough stays saturated — light bends and CONCENTRATES, not a flat lerp), perceptual color travel with zero muddy-grey midpoints, ~9.5% film grain, and a slow atmospheric breathe (frame-to-frame RMSE ~0.038 at rest — alive but never panning). BURST — sharp triangular conic wedges from an off-card focal (burst crop bimodal: min 0/max 251/std 32 = hard sector edges against black card), each wedge a distinct brand hue, with a soft radial light-bloom toward the focal point and a clean specular glint where the glass dock-pill + circular search button composite OVER the live prismatic field. The whole field is TRUE translucent liquid glass underneath the floating chrome — content reads through.
findings.ourState: FOLDS register is SOTA and shipped: src/components/custom/aurora/constants/shaders/aurora.frag.ts:272 domainWarp (Quilez canonical double fBm warp), composition.glsl.ts:25 nucleiField (anisotropic-Gaussian softmax color attractors), composition.glsl.ts:15 samplePalette (linear-baked OKLCh LUT, color.ts oklchToLinear), aurora.frag.ts:412 aces + :425 IGN dither + :413 film grain. The warm-cream default (presets.ts:282, hue 45-70) reads warm-cream at rest — correct identity. Motion is honest: atoms-fields.ts:48 breathing register (nucleiDrift 0.005/paletteDrift 0.006/warpDrift 0.003) is the calm-alive register matching Apple's drift. WebGPU-first primary (aurora.wgsl.ts) ships the same smooth field. WHERE WE FALL SHORT: (a) NO prismatic radial-burst composition primitive — nucleiField is exclusively soft-Gaussian; flow.glsl.ts:24 flowPattern radial/swirl only ORIENTS strokes for painterly mediums, it never paints the color field, so the hard angular conic-sector station register is unreachable; (b) the single-ridge specular light-concentration is implicit (nuclei valueBias + breath) rather than an explicit per-fold light-bending term, so our folds read flatter than Apple's silky catch-light crest; (c) the demo presets (demo/stories/aurora/presets.ts: OPENAI_SKY/DAWN/MEADOW + van-Gogh/oil) cover smooth + painterly poles but ship NO burst/station preset and no Apple-fold-tuned warm-specular preset.

findings.summary: The iOS-27 Maps SHOT is a complete CARD + ICON-BAR + FLOATING-CONTROL reference glass-ui only half-supports. (3) Floating circular near-colorless frosted glass map controls (binoculars/location-arrow) + a recessed darker search-pill well inside the card — neither a standalone floating-circular-control nor a recessed-map-search register exists. The bronze/blue/gold map cleanly onto existing brand-metal + section-color tokens, so the recipe is token-first.

findings.ourState: THE CARD: `src/styles/drawer.css:66-67` — `.glass-drawer` composes `background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--glass-bg-overlay), …)` + `backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur-overlay)`, and `--glass-opacity-overlay: 0.95` (`src/styles/tokens/glass.css:58`) → a functionally OPAQUE plate; our bottom-sheet does NOT read-through like the Maps card (the map should modulate the body). findings.lens: res-apple-hig — Apple official Liquid Glass guidance (the authoritative bar)
findings.summary: Apple's official spec (newsroom + HIG) defines Liquid Glass as a translucent material that "reflects and refracts its surroundings, while dynamically transforming to help bring greater focus to content," uses "real-time rendering and dynamically reacts to movement with specular highlights," and "combines the optical qualities of glass with a fluidity only Apple can achieve, as it transforms depending on your content or context." Two variants exist (Regular — adaptive/full-legibility, the default; Clear — permanently translucent for media-rich surfaces over a dimming layer), and the load-bearing rules are dynamic light/dark adaptation, the dimming/legibility layer, fluid morphing (controls shrink-to-focus then fluidly expand; surfaces morph per context), and concentric/nested corners. We match the material FOUNDATION well (squircle, deep tier, specular/edge-glint, bloom-from-source, dynamic darkening) but we do NOT yet realize the HALLMARK morphs the references prove: the now-playing PILL contextual dock morph, the GOO-SPLIT sub-dock, and the album-card→fullscreen BLOOM-UP FLIP. Our deep tier also stops at blur(16px) vs Apple's 20px ceiling, and concentricity is component-local, not a system register.
findings.bestInClass: Apple's authoritative bar, per the official spec + the reference frames: (1) MATERIAL — a multi-layer optical stack: translucency + real-time REFRACTION/lensing of surroundings + motion-reactive SPECULAR highlights + a shadow/illumination layer; Regular variant intelligently adapts light↔dark and reads surrounding content for its tint; Clear variant stays translucent and rides a DIMMING LAYER for legibility over media. Apple home-nav measures saturate(1.8) blur(20px), product tiers blur(14–20px). (2) DYNAMIC ADAPTATION — "intelligently adapts between light and dark environments," dims dynamically over bright/busy backdrops to protect legibility (the iOS 26.x refinement added a USER transparency SLIDER + layers baked into icon artwork — Apple's own answer to the NN/g "text-on-text / low-contrast" critique). (3) MORPHING/ELASTICITY — controls "shrink to bring focus to the content while keeping navigation instantly accessible," then "fluidly expand"; surfaces "transform depending on your content or context"; the Lock Screen time "fluidly adapts to fit elegantly behind the subject"; tab bars/sidebars REFRACT content behind them. The reference frames add the concrete hallmark choreography: the 5-tab dock COLLAPSES into a now-playing PILL (album-chip + track text + play + search, content reading THROUGH), GOO-SPLITS a circular sub-dock button, and album cards BLOOM UP into the full Now-Playing screen (FLIP+fade from the card rect). (4) CONCENTRICITY — nested elements share concentric corner radii; controls are capsule/circle by default. (5) ACCESSIBILITY — honors Reduce Transparency (→ opaque), Reduce Motion (→ no morph/shimmer), and the legibility floor is non-negotiable (NN/g: "Text on top of images is a bad idea… contrast too low"; "Motion for motion's sake is not usability. It's distraction with a side of nausea").
findings.ourState: We have a strong MATERIAL foundation. The unified `.glass-material` atom (src/styles/glass/material.css:36-185) carries the motion-reactive specular catch-light + the angle-keyed RIM edge-glint (W-LENSING), `plus-lighter` blend Safari-16.4-gated (material.css:174-179) — Safari-compatible by construction. Bloom-from-source is shipped: `.glass-reveal` (src/styles/glass/reveal.css:42-112) blooms top-layer surfaces from `--reka-popper-transform-origin` on the snappy spring with a coupled scale+opacity+filter-blur-settle and a PRM carve (reveal.css:120-136); `useLiquidReveal` is the JS source-rect refinement and `useDockCtaReceive` (src/composables/motion/useDockCtaReceive.ts) morphs an external CTA ONTO a dock control. Dynamic darkening (the Regular-variant adaptation) is the W55/W-DARK-MATERIAL adaptive-glass seam (self-engage + sampled-luminance observer). The deep tier exists (src/styles/glass/deep.css; src/styles/tokens/glass-deep.css) but its blur CEILING is 16px (glass-deep.css `--glass-blur-deep-radius: 16px`) — STRICTLY below Apple's measured 20px home-nav ceiling, which the file itself records as BOOKED-but-unshipped. Squircle corners exist (src/styles/glass/squircle.css, 66 lines) and concentric radii are used (src/styles/segmented-tabs.css:42-85; src/styles/dock/shell.css:387) but ONLY component-locally — there is no system concentric-radius register. The SHORTFALL vs the hallmark: a grep for goo-split/now-playing/sub-dock/context-pill/album-bloom returns ZERO — `morph-bridge.css` (the SVG-goo) exists but is scoped ONLY to the V↔H orientation-flip showcase (its header: "DECORATIVE only… hides the V↔H dock topology jump-cut"), NOT a now-playing pill or a goo-split sub-dock; `useContextualDockLayers` is referenced only in a README, not shipped as a primitive. BLOOM-UP with GRAVITY: the album card doesn't just scale to fullscreen — it arrives with the audacious-arrival --ease-out (no bounce on the big move) while the album ART crossfades and the controls cascade in 60ms-staggered (the W-HIERARCHY2 gravity entrance applied to the now-playing controls).

The Maps tinted-glass icon-chips (Work=bronze/Home=blue/Walmart=gold) are EXACTLY our IconChip + glass-accent + the brand-metal triad — promote them to FULL circular glass CONTROLS (not just decoration): a circular glass button whose rim+core tint toward its data hue, with the specular gleam tracking the pointer. findings.lens: res-awwwards — SOTA web liquid-glass + dock/morph implementations, Safari-first
findings.summary: The web's SOTA liquid-glass splits into two tiers with a hard Safari fault-line down the middle. Tier 1 (cross-engine, Safari-first) is the backdrop-filter blur+saturate+brightness frosted plate + a layered highlight/tint/shadow stack + compositor transform/opacity/filter morphs — exactly what glass-ui already ships well (.glass-reveal, the ::before specular, the CSS-SVG goo threshold bridge). Tier 2 (the "real refraction" everyone chases — feDisplacementMap edge-lensing + chromatic aberration + superellipse corners) is FUNDAMENTALLY Chromium-only: backdrop-filter:url(#svg) does not work in Safari/Firefox (WebKit bug 245510), confirmed by primary CSS-Tricks sources and by our own glass-refract.css which gates the whole thing behind @supports and had to BAKE the press-swell scale because var() can't splice into a url() token. The creed (DOCK is the hallmark, Safari-first) therefore demands: do NOT chase SVG-displacement refraction as the load-bearing path — invest the dock's WOW in the Safari-safe metaball goo-SPLIT (we ship a real WebGL2 metaball AND a CSS-SVG threshold goo, both Safari-OK) and contextual reconfiguration, which is precisely the iOS-27 hallmark we have NOT built (the dock fissions into a now-playing pill + a detached circular sub-dock; ours only MERGES/morphs, never SPLITS).
findings.bestInClass: The iOS-27 reference bar (V1 f_030/f_055, the Maps shot): the 5-tab translucent glass dock is TRUE liquid glass — the album grid reads cleanly through the plate (f_055), the selected tab is a glass-floating plate not a saturated fill, and a now-playing PILL floats above the dock mid goo-SPLIT, having fissioned a detached circular sub-dock (the magenta search circle bottom-right + a music chip left in the Maps shot). The split/merge is a true metaball goo (alpha-bleed + threshold), the reconfiguration is per-context (the dock becomes a pill + sub-dock when playing). Album cards BLOOM UP into the full Now-Playing screen via a FLIP+fade (shared-element source-rect bloom). Aurora artwork (V2 f_012) is silky warm-orange light-bending folds. SOTA web that matches this Safari-first: (1) the frosted-plate floor — backdrop-filter: blur(14-20px) saturate(1.5-1.8) brightness(1.06-1.18), the iOS register, plus a layered highlight(top-inset)/tint/under-shadow stack mimicking Apple's 3-layer glass (CSS-Tricks 'Getting Clarity on Apple's Liquid Glass'); (2) the CSS-SVG GOO metaball — feGaussianBlur the alpha of two plates so they bleed, then feColorMatrix-threshold the alpha back to a sharp edge (the classic gooey-CSS trick, Safari-compatible because it's filter: on the element's OWN pixels, not backdrop-filter:url); (3) macOS-dock magnification + spring-fan stacks (Framer-Motion-class, all transform-only → Safari-safe). The SVG feDisplacementMap edge-refraction + chromatic-aberration (separate R/G/B displacement) is the visual ceiling but is Chromium-ONLY and must stay a progressive @supports enhancement, never the load-bearing read.
findings.ourState: glass-ui's Safari-safe liquid floor is genuinely SOTA-grade and largely matches the bar: (1) .glass-reveal (src/styles/glass/reveal.css:43-112) is a coupled spring-clocked scale+opacity+filter-blur bloom-from-anchor, compositor-only, PRM-carved — fully Safari-compatible, mirrors the iOS popover bloom. (2) The ::before moving-specular catch-light (src/styles/glass/material.css:60-92) rides filter/mix-blend on the surface's own pixels — Safari-OK. (3) The CSS-SVG goo metaball bridge (src/styles/dock/morph-bridge.css) is the Safari-safe feGaussianBlur+threshold trick, deterministic on --dock-morph-t. (4) We ship a REAL WebGL2 metaball (src/components/custom/goo-blob/) — Safari-compatible, an even higher-fidelity goo source. BUT three gaps vs the bar: (A) THE GOO-SPLIT IS ABSENT. The bridge only MERGES (V↔H morph via useDockOrientationMorph) or morphs pill→search-field (useDockSearch.ts:1-130); it NEVER SPLITS the dock into a now-playing pill + a DETACHED circular sub-dock (the iOS hallmark, f_055/Maps shot). grep for split/fission/sub-dock finds nothing in the dock. (B) THE REAL REFRACTION IS CHROMIUM-ONLY AND HOBBLED. .glass-lens (src/styles/glass-refract.css:60-111) is gated behind @supports (backdrop-filter: url(#…)) — explicitly Chromium-only (WebKit bug 245510 cited at :62), and the press-swell scale animation was DROPPED/baked (DDR-LENS-BAKE, :34-58) because var() can't splice into a url() token. So Safari users get zero edge-refraction and zero press-swell. Same Chromium-only ceiling on corner-shape: superellipse() squircles (src/styles/glass/squircle.css:36-53). (C) CONTEXTUAL RECONFIGURATION + ALBUM BLOOM-UP unbuilt — useLiquidReveal exists for source-rect bloom but no dock-reconfigures-per-context state machine and no card→fullscreen shared-element FLIP.

gaps.gap: The iOS-27 goo-SPLIT sub-dock is absent — the dock's signature behavior. The dock must FISSION (metaball goo-split) into a now-playing/context PILL + a DETACHED free-floating circular sub-dock button (f_055 now-playing pill above the 5-tab dock; the Maps shot magenta search circle bottom-right + music chip left). We have the Safari-safe metaball substrate (CSS-SVG threshold bridge + the real WebGL2 goo-blob) but it only MERGES/morphs, never SPLITS into two detached docks. This is THE hallmark and the creed's headline.

findings.summary: The Apple Music iOS-27 reference (V1) shows a dock that does THREE morph moves we only partially have: (1) full 5-tab translucent-glass tab-bar that COLLAPSES into a now-playing PILL (f_001→f_035); (2) a GOO-SPLIT where the collapsed pill sheds SATELLITE glass buttons — a left music-chip + a right magenta search circle — that stay metaball-connected at the seam and reconfigure per context (f_030/f_032/f_034); (3) popovers/cards that BLOOM from their trigger (f_035 the '+' popover; album cards FLIP-fade-up to Now-Playing). The canonical Safari-safe goo technique is the Kocienda/Lucas Bebber gooey filter — `feGaussianBlur(stdDeviation≈7-10) → feColorMatrix(alpha *18..20, -7..-9) → feComposite(operator=atop)` applied via a REGULAR `filter:url(#goo)` (Safari-safe), NOT `backdrop-filter:url()` (Chromium-only — confirmed in our own useGlassRenderer.ts:24 / glass-refract.css:61). Our rail (DockStack) is a clean stagger of detached glass icons ('NEVER a shadowed half-tucked chip'), explicitly NOT the seam-connected goo-split.

findings.lens: res-aurora-sota
findings.summary: V2's hallmark aurora is the "Heavy Rotation" SILKY-SATIN LIGHT-BENDING FOLD (f_004/f_007): a smooth, glossy, anisotropic surface where warm light bends and concentrates along soft folds — like brushed liquid metal or folded satin catching a soft key light, NOT a painterly/grainy field and NOT a flat blurry blob. Our aurora has a deep, SOTA foundation (anisotropic-Gaussian nuclei softmax + Quilez double domain-warp + OKLCh-perceptual palette ramp + ETF/structure-tensor flow + Bridson curl warp + 7 painterly mediums incl. Kuwahara + ACES + IGN dither + a WGSL primary at parity), but its `smooth` default (uMedium==0) is a FLAT domain-warped gradient with ZERO sheen: it produces a soft "premium-SaaS mesh-gradient" (RESEARCH.md β=-2.75 "rolls off too steep") that reads as a blurry blob, never satin. Blinn specular exists ONLY inside the oil impasto paint-HEIGHT relight (brush.glsl.ts:265-284), never on the smooth pole. The genuine SOTA gap is a new SMOOTH-glossy register — an anisotropic light-bending "satin/silk" finish — plus the unauthored "Stations" prismatic radial-burst look. Both are reachable single-pass WebGL2 + WGSL, Safari-safe, within the existing one-pass/no-FBO/PRM-frozen contract.
findings.bestInClass: THE BAR from V2 + SOTA references: (1) Apple Music animated artwork = a SwiftUI MeshGradient-class technique — Coons-patch bilinear interpolation over a small grid of moving color control points, P3/linear color space, `smoothsColors` (developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/meshgradient confirmed) — animated by slowly drifting the control-point POSITIONS, giving smooth large-wavelength folds with NO visible noise grain. (2) The "Heavy Rotation" satin look (f_004) is that mesh field PLUS an anisotropic SHEEN: light concentrates into bright specular folds running along the gradient's flow direction (brushed-metal / folded-fabric — a height-field-derived normal lit by a soft key, specular gated to the fold ridges). (3) The "New Music"/"Chill"/"Get Up!" cards (f_001/f_013/f_020) are softer mesh fields with one diffuse bright lobe; "Chill" shows a green→teal→blue 3-stop perceptual sweep with a soft radial glow lobe. (4) The "Stations" tiles (f_001 bottom) are a PRISMATIC RADIAL-BURST: saturated rainbow rays fanning from a corner focal point (a conic/angular palette sweep + radial mask). (5) Color is buttery-smooth, large-wavelength, dithered (no banding), warm-identity. (6) Animation is a slow living breathe (~5-15s), never frantic. (7) paper.design ships these as "fast one-pass WebGL, renders instantly, no spinner" (paper.design/blog) — the single-pass no-FBO bar we already hold. The BAR to BETTER: make the satin fold ALIVE + interactive (light follows pointer), give the rail/dock a per-context aurora tint that morphs hue with the dock, and make the radial-burst a real station register.

findings.lens: aud-glass — our glass MATERIAL vs iOS-27 liquid glass
findings.summary: Our 5-rung ladder + `--glass-level` (opacity/blur) + `--glass-tint-*` (adaptive darken) + `--glass-accent` (rim) + `.glass-deep` + `.glass-lens` is a genuinely deep token system — arguably MORE parameterized than iOS-27 on the legibility/dark axes. But it is calibrated for ONE archetype (a warm-cream rounded card/dock over a procedural backdrop), and against iOS-27 Music/Maps it falls short on four material truths the reference makes load-bearing: (1) the REFRACTION is broken-by-policy — the `.glass-lens` SVG displacement filter is baked-static (no press-swell), Chromium-ONLY behind `@supports (backdrop-filter:url())`, and carries ZERO chromatic dispersion, so Safari — the explicit creed target — gets NO lensing at all and the warm light-bending fold of f_006 has no analogue; (2) the iOS-27 TINTED-GLASS CHIP (Maps Work/Home/Walmart circles — a fully colored translucent glass plate per-instance) has no first-class home — our `--glass-accent` tints only the RIM+specular-core, never the plate FILL; (3) the squircle is RE-HOMED off cards/pills/buttons by policy (only the big-dock + overlay band get `corner-shape`), so our circular chips/cards do NOT carry the iOS continuous-corner read where iOS-27 does; (4) there is NO ambient page-tint (f_065: the whole album page absorbs the artwork's warm-brown hue) and the deep tier ships at 16px/sat-1.5, short of the measured Apple 20px/1.8. The material is rich; the GAPS are refraction-cross-engine, tinted-fill chips, squircle-coverage, and ambient-tint.
findings.bestInClass: iOS-27 liquid glass, read off the frames: (a) CONTENT READS THROUGH every glass plate — in f_005/f_050 the album cards bleed visibly UNDER the 5-tab dock; in f_015 the mini-player pill AND the dock are two distinct translucent layers with the search grid showing through both; the Maps SHOT bottom-sheet shows the map through its rounded top edge. (b) REFRACTION/light-bending is the signature: f_006 "Heavy Rotation" is silky warm-orange folds that BEND light — the rim concentrates and warps the backdrop, not a flat blur. (c) The squircle (continuous superellipse corner) is on EVERYTHING — the radio station tiles (f_005), the album cards, the dock pill, the Maps chips — the corner is the iOS fingerprint at every radius. (d) PER-INSTANCE TINTED GLASS CHIPS: the Maps SHOT circular icons are each a full translucent COLORED glass plate (bronze Work / blue Home / gold Walmart / blue Add) — a colored fill + matching rim, still see-through, still legible. (e) AMBIENT TINT: f_065 the entire album-detail page + its glass chrome absorbs the artwork's warm-brown dominant hue — the glass is not warm-cream-fixed, it samples the content. (f) The dock + mini-player + sheet all carry a bright top catch-light rim + soft under-shadow reading as physical glass THICKNESS. (g) Deep refractive blur measured at Apple ~saturate(1.8) blur(20px) on the live nav material.

Distinct from accent-tone.css (a control-fill register) — this is the standalone glass-circle chip. ≥2 consumers: Maps-style nav chips + the configurator ColorSwatch.

gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-DEEP-PUSH: run the profile:budget clearance and (if green) land the booked 18-20px deep radius on the existing --glass-depth LERP (no recipe edit — the successor the glass-deep.css L4 budget-call already wired), lifting the hero/dock/CTA toward the live Apple ceiling.

jubilance: GOO-SPLIT the lens: when the dock collapses into the now-playing pill and goo-splits the circular sub-dock (the V1 hallmark), couple the metaball merge to a transient --glass-refract-swell so the two plates' rims VISIBLY bend the backdrop toward each other at the bridge point — light pinches where the goo necks, then snaps clear as they separate. Liquid glass that LENSES while it splits.

Tinted-glass chips that SAMPLE the icon: a <GlassChip> whose --glass-fill-tint auto-derives from the dominant hue of its own slotted glyph/album-art (the Maps SHOT read), so a Work chip goes bronze, a music chip goes its album's warm-orange — the chip is a tiny window tinted by what's inside it.

Touch-illumination that bends light (apple-ios27 §2.5 made literal, cross-engine on the gradient floor).

Ambient 'glass absorbs the room' on the now-playing bloom: as an album card BLOOMS UP into the full Now-Playing screen (the V1 album-fade-up FLIP), ramp --glass-ambient-hue from neutral to the artwork's dominant hue over the bloom clock so the whole page + chrome WARMS INTO the album's color as it arrives — the f_065 warm-brown absorption, animated.

A 'liquid breathing' deep tier: under --glass-depth, let the dock/hero deep glass subtly pulse saturate 1.5↔1.6 on the calm --duration-metal clock (PRM-static) so the thickest glass reads ALIVE — light concentrating and relaxing like the f_006 silky folds, never a flat frost.

findings.lens: aud-tabs — SegmentedTabs indicator (glide+squish, elastic spring, drag-morph) vs the iOS-27 Apple Music tab-bar
findings.summary: Our SegmentedTabs engine is architecturally strong — ONE axis-derived indicator (anchor-positioned `inset` glide + JS fallback), a volume-preserving travel-squish capped at 1.15, a calibrated `--spring-snappy` clock (~340ms, release-at-arrival 0.82), and a genuinely novel `:draggable` liquid-pull (`useDragMorph` fling-to-nearest). But it MISSES the iOS-27 tab-bar gestalt on five concrete fronts. (1) Our active plate is a FORWARD-lifted near-white floating plate; iOS-27's active tab plate is a RECESSED/darkened glass capsule whose tint follows the active tab's ACCENT hue (red for Radio — f_005), not a hue-neutral near-white lozenge. (2) iOS-27 tabs are ICON-OVER-LABEL stacked with the icon+label recoloring to the accent on selection; our default tab renders label-only (the `icon` field exists in the type but the default markup never paints it). (3) The reference tab-bar momentarily FLOODS with the now-playing artwork color during a state change (f_007) — a jubilant color-suffusion event we have no analogue for. (4) iOS-27 collapses the tab-bar into a now-playing PILL that GOO-MERGES with the bar (f_006); our tabs have no collapse/contextual-morph register at all. (5) Our glide is a single bezier-spring on `scale` only — the iOS-27 indicator is a true liquid lozenge that overshoots+settles with the icon glyphs cross-fading their accent recolor coupled to the slide.
findings.bestInClass: iOS-27 Apple Music tab-bar (V1 f_001/f_004/f_005/f_006/f_007): FIVE-tab dock (Home/New/Radio/Library/Search), each tab ICON-OVER-LABEL stacked. The active tab paints a RECESSED darkened-glass capsule (a subtle inset lozenge, NOT a bright forward plate) AND recolors its icon+label to the section ACCENT hue (Home=red f_001, Radio=red f_005 with the pill, New/Library forming the plate mid-transition f_004/f_006). The whole bar is TRUE translucent liquid glass — album art reads through it (f_006 shows cards visible behind the bar). On a now-playing state change the bar momentarily FLOODS with the track-artwork accent color in a sweep (f_007 — the entire dock tints pink/red). The tab-bar COLLAPSES into a floating now-playing pill that GOO-MERGES with the bar at the occluded midpoint (f_006 — the pill descends into and fuses with the tab-bar via the gooey-CSS feGaussianBlur threshold, no hard topology cut). The indicator transition is a liquid lozenge that follows with a small overshoot+settle and the glyph accent-recolor cross-fades coupled to the slide. Maps shot: circular TINTED-glass icon chips (Work=bronze/Home=blue/Walmart=gold) — the per-instance chromatic-glass register a tab plate should echo.
findings.ourState: Engine is solid and SOTA-shaped. `useTabIndicator.ts:200-255` drives a volume-preserving travel-squish (`scale: var(--stretch) calc(1/var(--stretch))`, segmented-tabs.css:121) capped LOW at DEFAULT_INDICATOR_MAX_STRETCH=1.15 (constants.ts:19), released-at-arrival 0.82 (constants.ts:41, verified against the eased snappy response 0.42/ζ 0.78). Glide is anchor-positioned `inset` interpolation (segmented-tabs.css:157-189) with a JS center-anchored fallback (useTabIndicator.ts:105-137). `useTabDragMorph.ts` wires the genuinely-novel liquid-PULL: grab the indicator, follow finger ~1:1, velocity-squish, fling-to-nearest (`useDragMorph`, default `draggable:true` SegmentedTabs.vue:121). Roving-tabindex keyboard contract is correct (SegmentedTabs.vue:330-356). FALLS SHORT: (a) active plate is `--glass-bg-floating-tinted` — a FORWARD lifted near-white plate (segmented-tabs.css:90-122 + surfaces.css:282), the INVERSE of iOS-27's recessed accent-tinted capsule, and it carries NO per-tab accent hue (no `--glass-accent` binding on the indicator). (b) the `icon?:string` field (SegmentedTabs.vue:50) is NEVER rendered in the default markup — the template fallback is `{{ option.label }}` only (SegmentedTabs.vue:453,477), so an icon+label stacked tab requires a hand-rolled `#option` slot per consumer. (c) tab-text recolor is a flat `color` cross-fade to `--foreground` (segmented-tabs.css:245-248) — no accent-hue recolor, no coupling to the slide. (d) no collapse/contextual-morph register and no color-suffusion event exist. (e) glide animates `scale`+`inset` on a bezier-spring `linear()` — a real spring `linear()` curve but NOT a velocity-continuous physical lozenge (the drag path has it via useDragMorph, the CLICK path does not).

gaps.gap: Active-plate INVERSION — our forward near-white `--glass-bg-floating-tinted` plate is the opposite of iOS-27's RECESSED accent-tinted glass capsule. The plate must read as an inset darkened lozenge whose chromatic rim+tint follow a per-tab accent hue (the `--glass-accent`/`--glass-accent-strength` W-GLASS-ACCENT register already exists — bind it to the active option). Today every active tab is hue-neutral near-white.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-TAB-IOS-PLATE: re-register the active `.segmented-indicator` as a recessed accent-tinted glass capsule — compose `--glass-accent: <option.accent>` + a recessed inner-shadow rim (invert the forward `--glass-shadow-floating` lift to an inset), with a hue-neutral default when no accent declared (byte-identical no-op floor); π readback both modes + ba-gestalt navigation verdict

gaps.gap: Icon-over-label is NOT first-class — the `icon` field exists but the default markup renders label-only, forcing every consumer to hand-roll a `#option` slot to match the iOS-27 icon+label stacked tab. The reference tab-bar is ICON-PRIMARY (f_001/f_005).
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-TAB-ICON-STACK: render `option.icon` over `option.label` in the default markup (an `iconPlacement: 'stack'|'inline'|'none'` axis, lucide functional-component form like the dock rail's `isComponent()` precedent), the icon recoloring to the accent on selection coupled to the slide; the existing `#option` slot stays the override

gaps.gap: No accent-recolor of the glyph/label coupled to the indicator slide — iOS-27 cross-fades the active icon+label to the section accent hue AS the lozenge arrives. Ours flat-fades `color → --foreground` on the generic-fast clock, decoupled.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-TAB-ACCENT-RECOLOR: thread a `--tab-accent` per-option token; the active `.segmented-tab` recolors icon+label to it on the SAME `--tab-indicator-duration` window the indicator glides (the §6 EFFECTS-on-bezier / SPATIAL-on-spring split honored — color is the EFFECTS leg, position the SPATIAL leg), PRM-safe

gaps.gap: No color-SUFFUSION jubilance event — iOS-27 floods the whole tab-bar with the now-playing/section artwork accent on a state change (f_007). We have zero analogue; this is the single highest-impact 'FUN' nicety the reference surfaces for tabs.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-TAB-SUFFUSE-SWEEP: an OPT-IN `suffuseOn` event seam — on selection (or a consumer-fired `flash(hue)`) the track background sweeps a bounded `--glass-accent` color-wash across the bar L→R on the spring clock then decays to rest (compositor-only opacity/filter, PRM→instant, default-OFF — the one-color-event proportion fence holds)

gaps.gap: No tab-bar COLLAPSE/contextual-morph register — iOS-27 collapses the bar into a now-playing pill that goo-merges with it (f_006). SegmentedTabs is a static strip with no collapse axis; the dock band owns morph but the tab strip itself cannot contextually reconfigure.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-TAB-COLLAPSE-PILL: an OPT-IN `collapsible`/`peek` axis that morphs the strip into a single active-tab pill + a goo-bridge re-expand (compose the W-MORPH-SHOWCASE feGaussianBlur goo-bridge + `useLiquidFlex`, NOT a new engine; topology-limit-occluded per the AX.W42 fold) — books to a successor if the ≥2-consumer bar is unmet, but the SEAM is the iOS-27 hallmark

gaps.gap: The CLICK glide is a CSS bezier-spring, not the velocity-continuous physical lozenge the DRAG path already has — a rapid multi-tap re-targets via CSS transition restart (loses momentum), where the iOS-27 indicator and our own `useDragMorph` re-seat the live (position,velocity). The two selection paths have desynced physics fidelity.
gaps.proposedWave: BD.W-TAB-CLICK-SPRING: route the click-select glide through the SAME `SpringProgress`/`useDragMorph` re-seat the drag uses (velocity-continuous re-target on rapid re-click), so click and drag share ONE interruptible physical lozenge — not two clocks (the press-unify interruptible-spring precedent)

jubilance: Per-tab ACCENT chips: bind each option to its section hue (`--section-color-N`) so the active capsule glows that datum's color — Radio=red, Library=violet — the Maps tinted-chip register (Work=bronze/Home=blue) brought to tabs; the active tab literally lights up its own color.

The color-SUFFUSION sweep (f_007): on selection a bounded accent-wash ripples across the whole track L→R then decays — the single most expressive 'this app is ALIVE' nicety the reference shows; opt-in, one-color-event-fenced.

Goo-MERGE re-expand: when a collapsed tab-pill re-expands, the sibling tabs goo-split OUT of the active pill via the feGaussianBlur bridge (the dock goo-split hallmark applied to tabs) — tabs that are BORN from the active one, not popped in.

Icon BLOOM on select: the active icon does a sub-perceptual scale(0.85)→1 snappy-overshoot bloom (the IconChip `:reveal` spring-clock entrance) coupled to the lozenge arrival — the icon 'pops awake' as the plate lands under it.

A drag-FLICK rainbow trail: while liquid-pulling the indicator past tabs, each passed-over tab momentarily flashes its accent (a chromatic wake), so a fast fling paints a brief rainbow streak across the strip before settling — pure expressive delight, PRM→off.

findings.lens: aud-aurora — our aurora engine vs the V2 Apple Music iOS-27 generative artwork reference
findings.summary: Our aurora is a SOTA painterly-FIELD engine (multi-nuclei softmax + Quilez double-warp + structure-tensor edge-tangent strokes + 7 first-class mediums + anisotropic-Kuwahara + Bridson curl-warp + WebGPU/WebGL2 dual-substrate). It MATCHES or BETTERS the reference's SOFT-VOLUMETRIC register (the Chill/New-Music/Your-Essentials blob fields, V2 f_008/f_024) — we have richer color science (OKLCh ramp, ACES, IGN dither) and 7 painterly mediums Apple's smooth fields don't. But the reference shows THREE registers and we cleanly hit only one. We have NO register for the two MOST ARRESTING reference looks: (1) the "Heavy Rotation" SILKY SATIN FOLDS — warm-orange draped fabric with a continuous specular caustic running along ridges, a light-BENDING surface read (V2 f_006), and (2) the "Stations for You" PRISMATIC RADIAL BURSTS — sharp hue-spectrum spokes fanning from a corner focal point (V2 f_001/f_020 bottom). Our `flow.pattern:"radial"` only ORIENTS painterly strokes; it cannot sweep a hard prismatic spoke fan, and nothing in the engine produces a folded-satin specular sheet. The library default is also a static, calm 2-nuclei warm-cream wash — it never demonstrates the arresting register the creed demands.
findings.bestInClass: The iOS-27 Apple Music generative artwork is THREE distinct generative registers, all true light-bending liquid: (A) SOFT VOLUMETRIC blobs — large overlapping Gaussian color masses, slow drift, smooth OKLCh-grade gradients (Chill teal/green f_024, New Music pink f_001, Your Essentials violet f_008); (B) SILKY SATIN FOLDS — Heavy Rotation (f_006) is the BAR: warm-orange draped-fabric ridges with a CONTINUOUS specular highlight tracking each fold crest (a caustic/anisotropic-sheen read, like raked light on silk or brushed metal), giving real depth and light-bending, NOT a soft blob; (C) PRISMATIC RADIAL BURSTS — the Stations cards (f_001/f_020 bottom row) fan sharp saturated hue-spectrum SPOKES from a corner focal, a kaleidoscopic radial-spectrum sweep (blue→green→violet→magenta spokes radiating). All three read as TRUE translucent liquid glass material with smooth banding-free gradients and a subtle living drift. The timing is calm (no frantic motion), the color is vivid-but-tasteful, and each card carries ONE coherent palette identity per mood.
findings.ourState: We MATCH register A (soft volumetric) and exceed it on color science. The default config (`presets.ts:276` DEFAULT_AURORA_CONFIG) is a 2-nuclei warm-cream wash, softmaxBeta 3.0, smooth medium — a calm valid field but NOT arresting; the SPEEDTEST preset (`presets.ts:399`, softmaxBeta 2.4, 6 nuclei, alpha 0.26) is our closest analog to a Chill/New-Music blob field and reads well. We MISS register B entirely: there is NO satin-fold / specular-sheet capability. `relightImpasto` (brush.glsl.ts:269) does Blinn specular but ONLY on accumulated painterly STROKE height (gated `specGate=clamp(height)`, `brush.glsl.ts:289`) — it never produces a smooth folded-satin sheen on the bare nuclei field; the `smooth` medium reaches none of it. The domainWarp (aurora.frag.ts:272) is Quilez fbm/cellular/hybrid/curl — it FOLDS the boundary but carries NO directional specular highlight along the fold, so a warped smooth field reads as soft bands, never silk. We MISS register C entirely: `flowField` `uFlowPattern==1` radial (flow.glsl.ts:24) only sets stroke ORIENTATION for painterly mediums — README confirms "Flow drives stroke direction only, never which palette stop a pixel picks" — so a smooth-medium radial config produces NO visible spokes; there is no hue-keyed angular-spoke sweep anywhere. The WGSL primary (aurora.wgsl.ts) also LAGS the .frag: it ports the smooth core + a Kuwahara finish but NOT the full per-dab Starry-Night stroke cascade (booked W-AURORA-WGPU-MEDIUMS-STROKES), so on Safari (WebGPU-everywhere mandate) the painterly hero mediums degrade to Kuwahara — a parity gap against the creed's "no fallbacks on Safari."

gaps.gap: NO silky-satin-fold register: the 'Heavy Rotation' look (V2 f_006) — warm draped folds with a continuous specular caustic running along each fold ridge — has no engine path. The smooth medium produces soft bands; relightImpasto's specular is gated to painterly STROKE height only (brush.glsl.ts:289) and never lights the bare nuclei field. This is the single most arresting reference register and we cannot make it.
gaps.proposedWave: AUR.W-SATIN-FOLD: a new `medium:"satin"` (smooth-pole peer, uMedium==8) — derive a fold-height field from the domain-warp displacement (the warp ALREADY computes a vec2 displacement; take its divergence/curl magnitude as a height proxy), build a surface normal via dFdx/dFdy of that height, and apply an ANISOTROPIC sheen (Kajiya-Kay / strand-specular along the fold tangent) lighting the bare field — a continuous caustic ridge-line, NO strokes. Distinct DISJOINT axis from nuclei (a `composition: "nuclei"|"burst"|"folds"` selector). proof:aurora-prism + the angular-hue-monotonicity π.

gaps.gap: The LIBRARY default + demo presets never DEMONSTRATE the arresting iOS-27 registers. The default is calm warm-cream (DEFAULT_AURORA_CONFIG presets.ts:276); the 13 demo presets are an OpenAI/painterly catalog, none of which reproduces Heavy-Rotation folds or Stations bursts. The fold/burst registers especially want a gentle living shimmer (fold crests slowly migrating, spokes slowly rotating).
gaps.proposedWave: AUR-W-LIVING-SHIMMER: a per-register slow-shimmer term — the satin fold-line and the prism spoke-fan each get a gentle drift coupling (fold ridge migration on K_WARP, spoke slow-rotation on a new K_BURST) so the arresting registers read alive, never frozen; PRM-frozen single-frame preserved.

gaps.gap: Banding risk on the wide smooth fold/burst gradients. We have IGN display-space dither (aurora.frag.ts:425) which is good, but the satin-fold continuous-specular ridge + the prism radial falloff are exactly the wide-low-frequency gradients where 8-bit banding bites hardest; needs explicit verification the new registers stay banding-free.
gaps.proposedWave: folded into AUR-W-SATIN-FOLD / AUR-W-PRISM-BURST acceptance: the π readback asserts no visible banding across the fold ridge + the radial falloff (the existing aurora-arresting statistics arm extended).

jubilance: The SATIN-FOLD register is a jubilant win for the DOCK + cards: a now-playing pill or album card whose glass backdrop is warm-orange silk with a specular caustic that slowly migrates is pure iOS-27 delight — make the fold ridges gently CHASE the pointer (cursor-as-light already exists via uLightDir, AW.W8) so dragging across a satin card sends a light-bend ripple down the folds.

PRISM-BURST as a CELEBRATION moment: fire a one-shot radial prism burst from the dock's goo-split button or a completion event — a kaleidoscopic spoke-fan blooms from the focal then settles to calm. Ties the aurora to the CompletionSeal earned-gold register and the dock morph creed (jubilance on every morph).

A 'shimmer-on-play' coupling: when audio/scroll/interaction starts, the aurora's breath depth + fold-migration speed lifts briefly then eases back — the artwork visibly REACTS, the way Apple's now-playing art subtly pulses with the music.

Mood-keyed register auto-pick: a warm seed (h 25-75) → satin folds; a multi-hue seed → prism burst; an analogous cool seed → soft volumetric. One `seed` atom picks the arresting register that fits the color story — the engine chooses the iOS-27 look for you.

The prism spoke-fan composes beautifully with the existing OKLCh `increasing` hue-arc (uHuePath) — we already have the clean rainbow-sweep color math; the burst is mostly an angular SAMPLE of capability we ship, a high-leverage fun win.

findings.lens: aud-safari
findings.summary: glass-ui's liquid-glass stack is overwhelmingly Safari-SAFE by construction: the base 5-rung blur is build-time `-webkit-backdrop-filter`-paired (gated by proof:webkit-backdrop), every bleeding-edge primitive (`@starting-style`/overlay, scroll()/view()/timeline-scope, position-anchor, contrast-color(), light-dark()) sits behind an `@supports` query with a real floor, and the WebGPU viz invisibly rebuilds to WebGL2. The ONE genuine Safari-BROKEN-RISK is the `.glass-lens` SVG refraction: WebKit bug 245510 (`backdrop-filter: url(#svg)`) is STILL OPEN as of June 2026, and the codebase's OWN JS guard (`useGlassRenderer.ts:24` `isChromium && CSS.supports("backdrop-filter","url()")`) proves Safari returns TRUE for that `@supports` while rendering nothing — so the CSS `.glass-lens` `@supports` block can fire in Safari and DROP the blur (flat no-glass surface), the opposite of the intended graceful degrade. This is opt-in (`<Button :liquid>` + 3 demo stories) so blast-radius is small, but it is unverified on a real Safari and the team's own DELTA doc assumes (without capture) that it degrades. The dock morph hallmark + goo-split path are Safari-safe (JS-spring `clip-path` morph, WebGL goo, regular `filter:url()` teardrop — not backdrop).
findings.bestInClass: iOS-27 (the reference) renders ALL its liquid glass natively in WebKit — the dock morph/goo-split, the album-card bloom-up, the popover-from-trigger reveal, the frosted Maps bottom-sheet, the tinted-glass icon chips (SHOT), and the generative aurora artwork (V2 f_001-024) all paint as true translucent liquid glass IN Safari with zero degradation, because Apple ships the refraction/lensing as a native compositor material (not an SVG feDisplacementMap backdrop-filter). The bar: every liquid transition the user sees must read identically rich in Safari 26 / iOS 26 as in Chrome — the refractive edge-lensing (the single biggest "thick glass" tell), the goo-split metaball merge, and the bloom-from-source must all be Safari-FIRST, not Chromium-gated enhancements with an invisible-absence floor.
findings.ourState: SOLID Safari floor across the board EXCEPT the refraction lens. findings.summary: The dock is already SOTA in its morph ENGINE (one interruptible SpringProgress, one inheriting `--dock-morph-t` scalar driving box+chrome+stagger; root-span ramp; PRM-synchronous seat; V↔H orientation morph with a CSS-goo teardrop bridge; contextual-layers resolver; DockStack hover-fan rail; dock-search; cockpit preset; CTA-receive seat). But it is missing the three things that make the Apple Music iOS-27 dock the hallmark: (1) the GOO-SPLIT — a sub-dock button that physically FISSIONS off the dock and floats to a corner (V1 f_006/f_030/f_037: the magenta search circle splits off bottom-right + a music chip bottom-left while the 5-tab dock collapses to a now-playing PILL); (2) the CONTEXTUAL-PILL morph — the dock collapses not into a smaller version of itself but into a DIFFERENT-FUNCTION floating pill per route/state (the now-playing mini-bar), then re-expands back to the nav dock; (3) the BLOOM-from/to-fullscreen FLIP — a card or pill blooms UP into a full screen and back (V1 album→Now-Playing). Our V↔H goo bridge proves we can do metaball merges in CSS Safari-compatibly; we have never turned that into a real SPLIT/FISSION facility, only a showcase decoration. The RAIL (DockStack) is a macOS hover-fan today — not yet the contextual, gesture-rich, jubilant hallmark the creed demands. I propose a 9-wave DOCK-HALLMARK band that bests every facility, fully realizes the rail, and suffuses fun into every morph.

The current DockStack is a competent macOS-stack but it is NOT the iOS-27 rail: it is hover-only (no resting carousel), single-axis (no goo-split satellites), has no divider-seam anchor, no contextual reconfiguration, and no jubilance. The CLAUDE.md prose STILL describes the retired divider-carousel rail in full (major doc/code drift — the dock §DockRail section, the --dock-rail-seam-offset write, the proof:rail3 R1-R6 contract all describe code that no longer exists). Meanwhile the actual iOS-27 hallmark — the dock COLLAPSING into a now-playing pill then GOO-SPLITTING into circular tinted-glass satellite sub-docks (frame 045: magenta music-chip left + pill center + search circle right) — is UNBUILT, even though the Safari-safe SVG-goo primitive to do it (morph-bridge.css, deterministic on --dock-morph-t, zero-WebGL) already exists and is only used by the V↔H showcase. The rail must be re-conceived as a UNIFIED family: a resting floating-carousel of tinted-glass context chips (the Maps shot) that goo-splits OFF the dock pill (the Music shot) and reconfigures its facet set per context. This is the single biggest gap to the SOTA bar and the user's verbatim "FULLY implement the rail facility."
